name: Hierarchical Spatial Enumeration Optimization
definition: An optimization based on the observation that datasets contain coherent regions of uninteresting voxels (opacity zero). Encoded as a hierarchical spatial enumeration represented by a pyramid of binary volumes.
summary: Hierarchical Spatial Enumeration Optimization is a ray-tracing acceleration technique for volume rendering that uses a pyramid of binary volumes to efficiently skip empty regions, differing from geometric methods by targeting dense volumetric data.
